Rules: Review only: never modify files; build/test commands are allowed for verification.

CliTools.Name: dotnet
CliTools.UseCase: .NET SDK. Use `--nologo -v q` for build/test/restore to keep output terse. Always pass `--nologo -v q`; if one command fails, rerun only that command with `-v n` and filter with rg.

CliTools.Name: ilspycmd
CliTools.UseCase: Decompile .NET assemblies. Example: `ilspycmd -p assembly.dll`, `ilspycmd -t Namespace.Type assembly.dll`.

CliTools.Name: map-check
CliTools.UseCase: Validate a map document with `pwsh -NoProfile -File <path> -MapPath <map.md>`. Exit 0 is required; JSON on stdout (`ok`, `errors`, `warnings`, `stats`). Read-only.
